📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

🚀 The Role

We’re hiring a Senior GTM Manager to join the Buy Engine.

tem predominantly sells through a partner network to SME businesses, and this role owns partner activation from systems to story. You’ll build the automation layer that makes the programme scalable, run the events and community engine that builds trust in market, drive the ABM plays that generate targeted pipeline, and translate tem’s product complexity into narratives partners and buy-side clients actually use. The metric you move is new pipeline generated.

The job requires two gears running in parallel. You ship fast, drawing on experience rather than waiting for a brief. And you zoom out regularly to build the systems that mean the next quarter is easier than this one.

In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Ship the agentic workflows that take the manual drag out of events, partner comms, and product marketing.

  • Build our events programme into a system that enables more in-person and community engagement across the UK and abroad.

  • Run ABM plays that generate new pipeline, with clear leading metrics helping you iterate quickly.

  • Turn tem’s most complex product and pricing innovation into positioning partners can sell.

  • Develop the automated product launch workflow, from PM spec through to go-to-market brief.

🛠️ Responsibilities

  • Build and automate: design and ship the agentic workflows that remove manual drag from events, partner comms, and product marketing, and keep building the GTM automation stack as the programme grows.

  • Run partner activation: own the events programme end to end, drive stickiness and engagement on our core activation channels, and run GTM experiments inside tem’s fortnightly sprint rhythm, compounding the playbook sprint by sprint.

  • Translate complexity into narrative: turn the hardest parts of energy into positioning partners can sell and customers are persuaded by, and keep the market story consistent and specific.

  • Own the intelligence loop: turn customer insights into structured signals that actively challenge and improve our positioning and GTM priorities, and own competitive intelligence on our key GTM bets.

  • Measure what matters: track what each activation play costs in time and money and what it returns in pipeline, own the reporting inside the fortnightly rhythm, and build the institutional memory that means the engine doesn’t reset when people join or leave.

✅ Requirements

Must-Haves

  • Builder orientation: you ship fast, draw on experience, and don’t need a fully formed brief to move.

  • Systems thinking in parallel: you can zoom out from daily execution to build the infrastructure that scales the programme, and do both at once.

  • Marketing literacy across the full GTM stack: positioning, narrative, activation, and channel strategy.

  • Hands-on, daily use of AI or no-code tools, with evidence you’ve built real workflows rather than one-off experiments.

  • B2B or B2B2C channel experience: you’ve marketed through or to a partner network, not just direct.

  • Comfortable operating at pace in a Series B environment where the playbook is being written as you go and the standards matter.

Desirable

  • Experience owning or contributing to an ABM programme.

  • Community or events programme ownership.

  • Exposure to complex or regulated industries where product narrative is genuinely hard, such as energy, fintech, infrastructure, or healthcare.

🎁 Benefits & Perks

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Up to £1,200 or €1,200 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to £150 or €150 per month for wellbeing.

🤝 Interview Process

We move fast. Most processes take 2 to 3 weeks from first chat to offer. If you need us to adapt anything, let us know.

  • First call with our Talent Team.

  • Technical Interview with the Team (90 mins). You’ll meet with potential peers in this session and will discuss your approach to GTM systems design and partner activation.

  • Bar Raiser Interview with Stakeholders.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

data.title: Customer Success Manager
data.description:
Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices and 68% (and growing!) of NHS Trusts.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book that lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.

That sounds cool — what does a Customer Success Manager have to do with it?

Accurx works with 41 of the 42 NHS ICBs in primary care and is growing fast in secondary care. The relationships that make that possible — the trust, the renewals, the accounts that stay with us even when competitors come knocking on price — are owned by our Customer Success team.

We’re hiring three CSMs to grow the team across both primary and secondary care. You’ll own a portfolio of enterprise NHS accounts end-to-end, from implementation through to renewal. In primary care, it’s about protecting and deepening relationships that are already strong. In secondary care, it’s about building them from scratch in a market where Accurx Scribe is winning big and growing fast. Either way, it’s about being the person NHS organisations trust — the one who knows their priorities, anticipates problems before they arise, and makes Accurx genuinely indispensable.

The challenges you’ll solve as a Customer Success Manager

  • Own your NHS accounts end-to-end. You’ll manage a portfolio of 5–11 ICB or Trust enterprise accounts — building relationships, driving adoption, leading renewals, and keeping Accurx sticky even when the NHS is in flux. You’re the person your customers call first.

  • Build trust where Accurx is new. In secondary care, we’re expanding quickly into a more complex environment. You’ll help NHS Trusts get real outcomes from Accurx Scribe — building processes that don’t yet exist and earning the kind of trust we’ve spent years building in primary care.

  • Be a connector, not just an account manager. You’ll work across marketing, implementation, transformation, commercial ops, and finance. The best CSMs here don’t just manage accounts — they bring the voice of the customer back into the business and make things better for the whole team.

  • Build the playbook as you go. The team is scaling and many of our processes are still being written. You’ll contribute to and shape how account management works at Accurx. What works gets codified; what doesn’t gets challenged.

  • Navigate the NHS with patience and precision. NHS organisations are under enormous pressure — restructuring, funding uncertainty, stakeholder churn. You’ll hold relationships through difficult periods and keep Accurx front of mind even when it’s not their immediate priority.

You should apply if...

  • You own relationships, not just accounts. You’ve worked in customer success, account management, or a relationship-heavy role and you know the difference between being a yes-person and being a trusted advisor. Accurx has no commission plan — success here is measured by trust, retention, and real outcomes.

  • You push back constructively. You don’t jump when a customer says jump. You ask why — more than once — and you find a better solution. You’re empathetic but not a pushover.

  • You’re comfortable building from scratch. Processes aren’t fully defined here. You’d rather create structure than wait for someone else to do it, and you’re okay if the first version isn’t perfect.

  • You’re curious about the NHS. Whether you’ve worked in or around it or you’re coming in fresh — you’re genuinely interested in how it works and patient enough to navigate its complexity.

  • You’re AI-native. You use AI tools to work smarter — automating the routine so you can spend more time on the things that actually need you.

  • You’re a natural connector. You’re as comfortable in a room with a clinical lead as you are with a Trust’s Head of Digital Transformation or a commercial director. You adapt your style and bring people with you.

What’s in it for me?

You’ll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we’re led by our Principles and our mission to Solve Healthcare Productivity.

  • £50,000 – £70,000 salary + share options up to £15,000

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Flexible Working: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office 3 days a week, with core hours of 10am–4pm

  • Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

  • Family matters: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

  • We have our very own Chef! Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches will be provided, with the occasional sweet treat!

Want to know more about the company or the hiring process? Check out our Careers page and Candidate hub.

Find us across social media: Medium, LinkedIn, X, Instagram and YouTube.

Diversity and Equal Opportunities: We are an equal opportunities employer and a pleasant and supportive place to work. We particularly welcome applications from those who are significantly underrepresented in the technology sector, such as women, non-binary people, transgender people, people with disabilities, LGBTQIA+ community and individuals from Black and Minority Ethnic communities.

What we do. Electric Car Leasing

Why we do it. Greener. Fairer. Future.


Consumer growth at Octopus Electric Vehicles has accelerated quickly over the last two years, and paid media is a huge part of how we reach more drivers and grow the business.

We're looking for a brilliant Senior Performance Marketing Executive to take day-to-day ownership of our paid digital activity - with one big goal: help us get more from every pound we spend.

This is a hands-on role for someone who loves performance marketing at the detail level. You'll be in Google Ads regularly, analysing search terms, adjusting budgets and bids, spotting wasted spend, testing new approaches and working out where we can improve conversion and scale efficiently.

Paid search will be at the heart of the role, and you'll also help us explore and grow channels like Paid Social, Display and Programmatic, testing where they can add incremental value to our existing activity. 

You'll sit within our B2C Growth squad, reporting into the Senior Consumer Growth Marketing Manager, and work closely with our Content Creator, Design, Commercial and wider Marketing teams.

This would suit someone with strong hands-on performance marketing experience, perhaps from an agency or fast-paced in-house environment, who wants more ownership, more visibility and more opportunity to influence what happens next.


What you'll do

  • 🚀 Own our paid media campaigns: Build, manage and optimise campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads and Meta, with paid search as your core focus initially.

  • 💰 Make our spend work harder: Identify wasted spend, underperforming campaigns and opportunities to improve efficiency, with clear recommendations on where to push, pause, reduce or reallocate budget.

  • 📈 Optimise towards the outcomes that matter: Look beyond clicks and leads to understand which campaigns and audiences are driving better-quality customers and orders, and use that insight to improve performance.

  • 🖥️ Help us grow Display and Programmatic: Identify opportunities across prospecting and retargeting, shape audiences and creative approaches, launch tests, analyse performance and recommend where there is a genuine opportunity to scale.

  • 📊 Stay close to performance: Monitor spend, pacing and key metrics, spot changes quickly and turn the numbers into clear, practical recommendations.

  • 🧪 Test, learn and improve: Work with our Content Creator and Design team to test messaging, creative, formats, audiences and landing-page approaches.

  • 🎯 Keep campaigns clean and measurable: Make sure tracking, UTMs, audiences, naming conventions and campaign structures are set up properly so we can trust the data we're using to make decisions.

  • 🌐 Help improve what happens after the click: Support campaign landing pages and other digital experiences, including drafting copy and building or updating pages using our web tools when needed.

  • 🤝 Make campaigns happen: Coordinate briefs, creative, links, tracking and launches across the team so activity gets live quickly.


What you'll need

Strong hands-on paid search experience. You're confident building, managing and optimising Google Ads campaigns yourself, from search terms and match types to bidding, budgets and campaign structure.

A proper performance mindset. You naturally look at an account and ask: Where are we wasting money? What could perform better? What should we test next?

Good commercial judgement. You know the cheapest click or lead isn't always the best one, and you're interested in what actually drives better-quality customers and orders.

Confidence managing paid media budgets. You're comfortable keeping an eye on pacing, spotting where performance is changing and recommending where spend should move.

Experience with Display or Programmatic. Ideally, you've worked hands-on with Display campaigns, DV360, Campaign Manager 360 or similar platforms. You don't need to be a programmatic specialist, but you should understand the basics and be excited to help us grow this area.

Some paid social experience. Experience with Meta Ads Manager or other paid social platforms would be useful.

You're comfortable with the technical detail. You understand why conversion tracking, UTMs, audiences, naming conventions and clean campaign setup matter, and you're happy digging into data to work out what's going on.

Around 2-4 years of hands-on performance marketing experience, ideally in an agency, media business or fast-paced in-house environment. We're flexible on exact years - what matters most is your technical ability, curiosity and attitude.

Most importantly, you enjoy doing the work. You like being in-platform, finding opportunities and making things better, and you're proactive, commercially minded, low-ego and great to work with. Things move quickly here, priorities change and everyone pitches in, so you'll thrive if you're happy getting stuck in, helping others and figuring things out as you go.

data.title: Software Engineer (Future Hiring)
data.description:
About SugarAI UK Limited

SugarAI is redefining CRM for the age of AI.

We’re delivering on the original promise of CRM—turning fragmented customer and revenue signals into clear, prioritized action. Instead of more dashboards or surface-level insights, we help teams focus on what matters most and know exactly what to do next.

More than two decades after our founding, we’re entering a new chapter with clarity and momentum—building intelligent, intuitive solutions that work within the flow of how teams actually sell and serve. We’re focused on solving complex, real-world challenges where relationships, context, and precision make all the difference.

Our global team is united by a shared commitment to impact, ownership, and continuous growth. We create an environment where thoughtful ideas move quickly, where people are trusted to lead, and where flexibility supports how great work gets done.

If you’re excited to help shape what’s next in AI-driven CRM—and build technology that drives real outcomes—we’d love to meet you.

Where You Fit In: 
SugarAI ships AI-powered selling and sales intelligence products in a market that moves faster every day. We are focused on quality, functionality, and speed to delivery, and the engineers who thrive here don't treat AI tools as a productivity add-on they've fundamentally changed how they work, using agentic development workflows to go from specification to production-ready code faster than they could before, without sacrificing correctness or quality. 

This is not a role for someone who favors traditional software development, or is curious about AI-assisted development and plans to explore it. It's a role for someone who already works this way who writes clear, machine-readable specifications that feed the agentic development system, uses agentic development tools as standard equipment, and applies genuine critical judgment to what these tools produce before it ships. You'll build systems and features that power real customer outcomes in a B2B SaaS platform at scale, and you'll do it inside a delivery model where human judgment is the differentiating input, not the bottleneck. 

If you want to work on meaningful software with teammates who hold the bar high on both speed and craft, this role is for you.

This role operates on a hybrid model, with a mix of remote work and in-office collaboration at our Solihull location, specifically, working in-office a minimum of 2 days per week.

 

Disclaimer: When applying to this job posting, you are submitting your application for consideration of a role which may or may not actually exist, or be available now or in the future. Application submission is agreeing to be added to our Applicant Tracking System database, so we have the potential to surface your profile and reach out to you in the future, for opportunities which appear to be aligned to your background, experience or network.
 
To be considered for a specific job opening, please check out our Careers Page and apply to an active job posting. 

Impact You Will Make in the Role (Key Responsibilities): 

Agentic Development Systems 

  • Work from executable specifications — write clear SDD/BDD specs and acceptance criteria as the primary input for AI-assisted code generation, and keep them current as implementation evolves 

  • Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) as standard equipment across the full SDLC, from spec to implementation to test generation to code review 

  • Apply critical judgment to AI-generated code and agentic attestations before merge — assess correctness, edge cases, security implications, and alignment with the spec; your review is a real gate, not a formality 

  • Contribute to the team's agentic development practices: spec standards, attestation norms, and how the team uses AI tools responsibly 

Feature Delivery 

  • Design, implement, and ship features and components that are reliable, maintainable, and built to perform in high volume, high-availability SaaS environments 

  • Ensure agentic code is clean, well tested, and follows the standards that make it easy to understand and extend by both agentic systems and your teammates 

  • Own your feature areas end-to-end, from understanding the requirement to production delivery, including identifying and resolving defects before they reach customers 

Code Quality & Review 

  • Review outputs, including AI-generated code and agentic attestations, with the care and rigor the team depends on; catch what automation misses 

  • Orchestrate unit and integration test development that verifies real behaviour, not just execution paths; apply the same critical eye to test quality as to production code 

  • Contribute to the team's technical standards and raise the bar on engineering operations excellence across all facets of our AI SDLC 

Collaboration & Systems Thinking 

  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to understand requirements and build the right thing, not just the specified thing 

  • Think beyond your immediate feature: understand the systems your code interacts with, the data it produces, and the downstream effects of your design decisions 

  • Communicate clearly in writing in specs, in code reviews, in async updatesto keep cross-functional and globally distributed teams aligned 

  • Participate in agile and team ceremonies, including Sprint Review, Program Reviews, and other technical presentations 


What You Will Bring (Qualifications/Experience): 

  • 2–5 years of experience developing enterprise or SaaS software in production environments 

  • Personal fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) you use these in your daily work and real delivery scenarios, not as an experiment 

  • Hands-on experience with BDD/SDD frameworks and working from executable specifications as the primary input to development, this is how we work, not a practice you're learning on the job 

  • Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or modern SaaS language; comfort picking up new languages and frameworks as the work demands 

  • Experience with RESTful API design and consumption 

  • Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores 

  • Experience producing and maintaining automated test suites (unit, integration, or end-to-end) 

  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with CI/CD pipelines 

  • Strong written communication skills; able to write clear specs, meaningful code review feedback, and async updates for a global team 


Preferred Qualifications/Experience: 

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent) and microservices architectures 

  • Familiarity with containerization, infrastructure-as-code, or observability tooling 

  • Experience developing or integrating with AI/ML features in a production SaaS product 

  • Background in B2B SaaS, CRM, or revenue technology 

We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience comes in different forms; many skills are transferable; and passion goes a long way. Even more important than your resume is a clear demonstration of dedication, impact, and the ability to thrive in a fluid and collaborative environment. We want you to learn new things in this role, and we encourage you to apply if your experience is close to what we’re looking for. We also know that diversity of background and thought makes for better problem solving and more creative thinking, which is why we're dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.
 
Benefits and Perks:
Beyond a stellar work environment, friendly people, and inspiring work, we have some sweet benefits and perks:
 
·       UK Pension Scheme
·       Private medical and dental insurance
·       Health &Wellness Reimbursement Program
·       Unpaid sabbatical leave
·       Educational Resources - Career & Personal Development Program
·       Various discount programs (i.e. travel, virtual exercises classes, etc.)
·       We are a merit-based company with many opportunities to learn, excel and grow your career!

data.description:
About Ultralytics:

At Ultralytics, we commit to relentless innovation in the AI space and seek team members who resonate with our ambition to produce the world's best YOLO AI models. If you're obsessed with AI, eager to make an impact on the world, and thrive in dynamic, high-intensity environments, we invite you to apply for a position on our team.

🌍 Join the team powering the future of vision AI
Hello, hola, 你好, こんにちは, नमस्ते, hallo, bonjour! Thanks for stopping by — we know your time is valuable, so here's what makes Ultralytics special.

⚡ Who we are
At Ultralytics, we're on a mission to simplify AI for everyone. As the linkcreators of the world's leading Ultralytics YOLO models, we empower millions of developers, researchers, and companies worldwide to build state-of-the-art computer vision applications.

Following our $30M Series A round, we're expanding rapidly across our global hubs. This is an opportunity to join a fast-scaling, high-performance team that's redefining the future of vision AI — where ambition meets impact, and ideas become reality.

We move fast. We build boldly. We execute with purpose. And we do it together.

💼 About the role
As a Solutions Engineer, you'll turn complex computer vision problems into production systems built on YOLO. You'll lead technical discovery, design architectures, build benchmarks and proof-of-concepts, and guide customers from their first conversation to deployed models.

You'll work across Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering while partnering directly with customers in manufacturing, retail, security, robotics, and beyond. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who enjoys writing Python, training and optimizing models, deploying across cloud and edge, and owning outcomes throughout the customer lifecycle.

If you thrive on ambiguous problems, direct customer contact, and turning technical possibilities into measurable results, you'll fit right in.

🚀 What you'll do
Technical discovery and solution design

  • Own technical discovery, translate customer needs into architectures, and define measurable success criteria.

  • Evaluate customer data, recommend models, and design training, inference, and deployment strategies.

  • Lead technical qualification and solution design alongside Account Executives and Customer Success Managers.


Prototyping and deployment

  • Build Python prototypes with YOLO, OpenCV, PyTorch, and Docker.

  • Create benchmarks, integrations, and production-ready training and deployment workflows.

  • Deploy solutions across Linux, macOS, Windows, cloud, and edge environments.

  • Diagnose performance, data quality, inference, and hardware acceleration challenges.

  • Use the Ultralytics documentation and YOLO guides to deliver reliable customer outcomes.


Customer engagement and enablement

  • Deliver technical demos, workshops, architecture reviews, and proof-of-concepts that move opportunities forward.

  • Explain machine learning clearly to engineers, operators, executives, and other non-technical audiences.

  • Build trusted relationships and manage technical stakeholders from evaluation through production.


Ecosystem contribution

  • Turn customer solutions into reusable examples, deployment guides, integrations, and documentation.

  • Share feedback with Product and Engineering to improve the YOLO ecosystem.

  • Engage developers through the Ultralytics community and GitHub organization.


📈 What success looks like

  • 3 months: Ramped on the YOLO stack and customers, co-running discovery, and delivering your first demos and project kickoffs.

  • 6 months: Owning technical discovery and POCs end to end, unblocking live deals or at-risk accounts, and earning trust from the AEs and CSMs you support.

  • 9 months: Converting technical evaluations into wins or saves, shipping reusable assets, and providing actionable feedback to the wider organization.

data.description:
Tired of retail pharmacy?

Imagine working in a modern, technology-enabled online pharmacy where you can focus on accuracy, quality and patient safety—without standing behind a retail counter, selling OTC products or being interrupted every few minutes.

Modern pharmacy. State of the art renovated premises with onsite Free parking

data.title: Senior AI Product Engineer
data.description:
Do you want to build the AI systems that compliance teams rely on to investigate real financial crime? Are you excited about taking agentic workflows from prototype to production at scale? Do you want your work to directly help catch bad actors moving money across blockchains?

Elliptic is hiring a Senior AI Engineer to join our AI team. It is the team behind Elliptic's copilot, the AI product that helps compliance investigators trace fund flows, surface patterns, and respond to risk in real time. This role sits at the centre of that work, designing the agentic systems, LLM integrations, and backend services that turn complex blockchain data into useful answers.

You'll join a focused team that cares about the quality of what it builds and gives you the space to do your best work. There's real ownership here, breadth across AI and backend systems, and the freedom to turn good ideas into shipped products. The problems are technically challenging, and the work is visible.

The impact you will have:

As a Senior AI Engineer on the AI team, you'll own significant parts of the Agentic stack that power Elliptic's copilot. You'll lead the design of agentic workflows, drive technical decisions on how we build and operate LLM-based features, and help raise the engineering standard across the team. You'll partner with product, web engineers, and your engineering lead to take complex problems from ambiguity to shipped product, and you'll mentor more junior engineers as the team grows.

What you will do:

  • Design and build agentic workflows and AI-powered features that power Elliptic's copilot, using LLM frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph.

  • Lead the design of agents, tool integrations, and retrieval pipelines that turn complex blockchain data into useful answers for investigators.

  • Build and own evaluation frameworks that measure and improve the quality, reliability, and latency of LLM outputs.

  • Design and build the backend services, APIs, and event-driven systems that support these features, using TypeScript and Node.js.

  • Drive technical design reviews and architecture decisions for AI workstreams.

  • Mentor and coach more junior engineers through pair programming, code review, and design feedback.

  • Raise the engineering bar across the team by promoting good practices in testing, observability, and AI system reliability.

  • Influence cross-team decisions on how AI capabilities integrate with the rest of the Elliptic platform.

What you will achieve in the first 6 months:

  • Owned and shipped at least one significant AI capability end-to-end, from ambiguous problem statement through to production.

  • Driven the technical direction of an AI workstream, including architecture, evaluation, and rollout.

  • Established or improved at least one team practice for building AI systems (evals, observability patterns, prompt management, rollout safety).

  • Mentored junior engineers on AI engineering practices and contributed to their growth.

  • Built strong working relationships across product, web engineering, data engineering, and DevOps.

  • Started to influence adjacent teams on how Elliptic builds with AI.

You will be a great fit here if you:

  • Care about building AI systems that work reliably in production, not just demos.

  • Have strong instincts for trade-offs specific to LLM systems: cost vs latency vs quality, deterministic vs probabilistic behaviour, when to use an agent vs a workflow.

  • Can take ambiguous AI problems and break them into shippable pieces with clear evaluation criteria.

  • Communicate clearly with non-engineers (product, stakeholders, leadership) about AI capabilities and limitations.

  • Have coached or mentored other engineers and enjoy raising the bar through reviews, pairing, and feedback.

  • Are genuinely curious about the domain and find blockchain investigations and financial crime prevention interesting.

Our ideal candidate has:

  • 5-8+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 1-2 years of meaningful production work building LLM-powered features.

  • Direct experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar.

  • Hands-on experience building agentic systems: tool use, multi-step reasoning, planning, memory, and human-in-the-loop patterns.

  • Practical understanding of prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management, and managing the trade-offs of working with LLMs.

  • Experience building and running evaluations for LLM outputs (eval sets, LLM-as-judge, regression testing).

  • Strong backend skills in TypeScript / Node.js, with solid API design.

  • Cloud experience (AWS: Lambda, ECS, S3, or similar).

  • Database proficiency across SQL (Postgres) and some NoSQL exposure.

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and coach other engineers.

  • Uses AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, Claude, etc.) critically and effectively as part of their day-to-day workflow.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, or similar).

  • Experience designing multi-agent systems and agent orchestration patterns.

  • Familiarity with LLM observability tools (LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize, or similar).

  • Experience working with multiple model providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, open-weight models) or with fine-tuning.

  • Hands-on experience with Terraform, Kubernetes, or infrastructure-as-code tooling.

  • Experience with observability platforms like Datadog.

  • Distributed or event-driven architectures (SNS, SQS).

  • Interest in cryptocurrency, blockchain, or compliance.

Job Benefits

> How we work:

  • Hybrid working and the option to work from almost anywhere for up to 90 days per year

  • £500 Remote working budget to set up your home office space

> Learning & Development:

  • $1,000 Learning & Development budget to use on anything (agreed with your manager) that contributes to your growth and development

> Vacation/ Leave:

  • Holidays: 25 days of annual leave + bank holidays

  • An extra day for your birthday

  • Enhanced parental leave: we provide eligible employees, regardless of gender or whether they become a parent by birth or adoption, 16 weeks fully-paid leave and leave.

> Benefits:

  • Private Health Insurance - we use Bupa!

  • Full access to Spill Mental Health Support

  • Life Assurance: we hope you will never need this - but our cover is for 4 times your salary to your beneficiaries

Head of Global Cybersecurity Operations, HSBC

Right now, our biggest opportunity is ramp: getting reps fluent and confident on our messaging faster, so they're telling a consistent, compelling story from day one. That's where you'll start.

  • Proven experience building and delivering training or ramp programs for sales teams, not just producing content for them

  • A track record of translating technical product capability into messaging that's straightforward and jargon-free

  • Comfort working autonomously across multiple solution areas at once, with the ability to prioritise as things shift

  • Strong cross-functional instincts — you'll work closely with Product, Sales, Sales Engineering, and Marketing, in both the UK & US

  • Sharp writing and presentation skills; you can make complex things simple and engaging

Metaview is an AI company focused on recruiting. We build AI agents that help world-class companies hire with radically more speed and precision. We automate the toil, and augment the human for companies like Brex, Affirm, Deel, ElevenLabs, and Airtable.

Founded by Siadhal and Shahriar after their experiences scaling Uber and Palantir, we’ve raised over $50m from top-tier investors. Most recently, Google Ventures led our series B. We’re growing 5x YoY, our customers are raving fans of the product, and our story has been covered in Fortune, Forbes, TechCrunch, and The Times.

It’s still day 0: Now is the time to re-engineer how work gets done with AI at the core, and our toughest challenges still lie ahead. We’re looking for people seeking the hardest, most fulfilling work of their lives.

How we work

We operate with one core principle: velocity. In practice, this means we:

  • Optimize everything we do around accelerating rate of learning.

  • Do truly great work

  • Communicate openly and directly, and with full context.

All while maintaining a hard-earned reputation for craft and quality.

The role:

We’re at an exciting inflection point: strong customer love, clear product–market fit, and accelerating growth. As our GTM Recruiter, you’ll partner directly with GTM leadership to build a world-class commercial organization. You’ll own the full GTM recruiting lifecycle with an emphasis on Sales, while also build on the foundational systems, processes, and tools that will scale our hiring engine. All while working within the business operating at the bleeding edge of how hiring gets done with AI.

Key ownership areas:

  • Partner with the Co-founder/CEO and GTM leaders to define hiring needs across Sales, CS, and Marketing.

  • Own end-to-end recruiting for GTM roles: sourcing, outreach, screening, stakeholder alignment, interviews, and offer processes.

  • Refine our recruiting infrastructure and keep making it sharper.

    • The bigger opportunity: build a hiring machine that combines systematic rigour with human judgement; 100x'ing our capacity and leaving the competition at the starting line.

  • Develop genuine expertise in GTM talent markets. Where the best operators are, what they care about, what it takes to land them.

  • Keep leadership honest. Surface pipeline realities and translate them into clear, data-driven decisions, trade offs, and next steps.

What you bring:

  • 3+ years in full-cycle recruiting at a fast-paced, high-growth B2B startup (experience hiring for GTM roles desirable)

  • A skilled assessor with an unusually high bar for talent. You can assess the intangibles that separate exceptional candidates from competent ones, and sell the opportunity in the same breath.

  • A network, or the hunger and discipline to build one fast. You know where the best GTM operators are, what they care about, and how to get their attention.

  • AI-native. You've already figured out how to use it to move faster and hire better. You're not waiting for permission or a playbook.

data.title: Senior AI Engineer (GTM)
data.description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 6000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

 

The role:

We’re looking for an entrepreneurial and technically strong Senior AI Engineer to join our Data & AI team and work with our Go-To-Market organisation.

This is a builder's role, end to end. You’ll work closely with Marketing, Sales, and RevOps to solve high-value problems, design practical AI solutions and build them into reliable systems that people use every day. You’ll be expected to move comfortably from an ambiguous business challenge to a technical design, a working prototype, and then a production-ready solution.

Your work could include building systems that segment and prioritise accounts, developing agents that automate sales workflows, or creating intelligent tools that help our teams research prospects and act on buying signals. You’ll own the full lifecycle of what you build, including evaluation, observability, reliability and cost optimisation.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being close to users, can write production-quality code and is excited by the challenge of turning rapidly evolving AI capabilities into valuable commercial outcomes. Experience working with GTM teams is useful, but the ability to understand problems, build effective systems and measure their impact is more important.

 

What you'll do:

  • Design and build AI-powered systems for account segmentation, enrichment, scoring, prioritisation and buying-signal detection

  • Develop and deploy agentic workflows for use cases such as account research, outbound personalisation, call summarisation and CRM hygiene

  • Write production-quality code and build the integrations, data pipelines and services required to take solutions from prototype to reliable daily use

  • Optimise systems for quality, latency and cost through evaluation, prompt design, model selection, routing, caching, context management and token optimisation

  • Establish practical patterns for building AI systems at Paddle, including monitoring, guardrails, documentation and clear measures of business impact

 

We'd love to hear from you if you:

  • Have strong software engineering experience and can independently take a problem from technical design through to production; Python and SQL experience would be particularly relevant

  • Have hands-on experience building applications with large language models, APIs, retrieval systems, agents or other applied AI technologies

  • Understand how to evaluate and operate AI systems in production, including managing hallucination risk, latency, reliability, context limits and variable model costs

  • Are comfortable working with structured and unstructured data, building integrations and turning information from multiple sources into useful systems

  • Have an interest in commercial problems and can understand concepts such as ICP, segmentation, pipeline, buyer intent and sales workflows; direct GTM experience is beneficial but not essential

  • Enjoy working directly with the people who use what you build, are comfortable with ambiguity and can balance speed, quality, and long-term maintainability

     

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.


Our Values

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

 

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We are a ‘digital-first’ company, which means you can work remotely, from one of our stylish hubs, or even a bit of both! We offer all team members unlimited holidays and 4 months paid family leave regardless of gender. We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

À propos de nAIxt Consulting / ILLUIN Technology

nAIxt Consulting est la practice conseil d'ILLUIN Technology, société née en 2017 au cœur de CentraleSupélec, l'un des clusters IA de référence en Europe. Spécialisée dans l'IA appliquée dans les entreprises (grands groupes, comptes publics, ETI, PME), ILLUIN est pionnière du NLP francophone et mène ses propres recherches en IA générative. Nos consultants interviennent en immersion chez le client pour déployer des solutions IA à fort impact (assistants conversationnels, automatisation documentaire, analyse de données), avec la vision agnostique des technologies IA (solutions du marché, produits Illuin, des approches sur mesure).

Le rôle

Nous recherchons plusieurs Forward Deployed Strategist (FDS) pour rejoindre nôtre équipe. Dans ce rôle, vous portez la stratégie d'intégration des solutions IA (de l’automatisation des tâches ponctuelles à la vision Agentic), l'adoption et l'orchestration des transformations IA, en collaboration avec les Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE). Immergé chez le client, vous faites le lien entre les décideurs, les métiers et les équipes de delivery pour transformer le potentiel de l'IA en usages réels et mesurables.

Vous pilotez la transformation IA d'un périmètre métier. Vous construisez la stratégie d'adoption, orchestrez les acteurs (direction, métiers, IT, Data) et garantissez un impact mesurable, du cadrage des cas d'usage jusqu'à l'ancrage des nouveaux usages.

Vos missions

Stratégie & cadrage

  • Construire la feuille de route IA d'un périmètre métier et la faire vivre

  • Qualifier et prioriser le portefeuille de cas d'usage selon la valeur, la faisabilité et les risques

  • Concevoir les processus cibles intégrant l'IA et les agents, et définir les interactions entre l'humain et l'IA

  • Construire les business cases et les critères Go / No Go avec les décideurs

  • Identifier dès le cadrage les prérequis de sécurité, de gouvernance et de qualité des données

  • Éclairer les arbitrages entre produits existants et développements sur mesure (Make vs Buy)

Orchestration de la transformation

  • Dialoguer d'égal à égal avec le Delivery Manager sur l'avancement, les risques et les arbitrages priorité/délai/périmètre

  • Être en mesure d'assurer un pilotage projet de bout en bout sur des missions à faible volumétrie ne justifiant pas un Delivery Manager dédié

  • Aligner direction, métiers, IT et Data autour d'objectifs et d'un plan partagés

  • Séquencer les déploiements pour que chaque cas d'usage renforce le suivant

  • Planifier les déploiements, anticiper les dépendances et lever les blocages

  • Piloter le passage des pilotes à l'échelle avec les équipes de delivery ILLUIN

  • Préparer et animer les instances de pilotage (Coproj, Copil)

Adoption & conduite du changement

  • Concevoir la stratégie d'adoption (formation, communication, relais métiers, rituels)

  • Construire les plans de montée en compétences

  • Installer et animer des réseaux d'ambassadeurs IA chez le client

  • Identifier les résistances et mettre en place les réponses adaptées

Impact & mesure

  • Définir et suivre les KPIs d'adoption et d'impact (taux d'usage, temps gagné, qualité, économies opérationnelles)

  • Mesurer les résultats et les présenter aux décideurs en comitologie

  • Mettre en place les dispositifs de retours utilisateurs et d'amélioration continue

  • Ajuster la trajectoire de déploiement selon les signaux terrain

Vie du cabinet

  • Encadrer et faire progresser des consultants juniors en mission

  • Contribuer à la prospection commerciale, aux propositions et aux soutenances

  • Capitaliser les retours d'expérience et enrichir les méthodologies et playbooks du cabinet

Profil recherché : avant tout, vous êtes passionné(e) par l’IA et souhaitez contribuer pour la rendre véritablement utile pour les entreprises

Formation

  • Bac+5 école d'ingénieur, école de commerce ou université

  • Spécialisation ou formation complémentaire en Data / IA et/ou en conduite du changement fortement appréciée

Expérience

  • 3 à 7 ans d'expérience, dont 2 ans au moins sur des projets IA, data ou transformation numérique

  • Vous avez accompagné au moins 2 projets de déploiement IA de bout en bout, du cadrage à l'adoption

  • Vous avez déjà préparé et animé des instances de Project Management et de pilotage face à des décideurs

  • Expérience en contexte grands comptes ou cabinet de conseil est fortement appréciable

  • Anglais courant est un plus

Outils & compétences techniques

  • Fondamentaux IA (LLM, RAG, agents) suffisants pour évaluer une faisabilité et dialoguer avec les Data Scientists

  • Construction de business cases chiffrés et de grilles de priorisation

  • Construction et présentation de dashboards (Tableau, PowerBI, Looker)

  • Bonne compréhension des enjeux data, gouvernance, sécurité et éthique IA

  • Compréhension générale des architectures cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • Notions de gestion de projet (planning, jalons, gestion des risques, méthodes Agile) suffisantes pour dialoguer avec un Delivery Manager et, si besoin, piloter seul un projet de moindre envergure

Compétences clés

  • Capacité à embarquer des acteurs aux intérêts parfois divergents

  • Data storytelling, vous présentez des résultats chiffrés de façon convaincante aux décideurs

  • Capacité à naviguer l'ambiguïté des grandes organisations

  • Veille IA active, vous intégrez les évolutions du marché dans vos recommandations

  • Orientation résultats, vous cherchez l'impact avant la production de livrables

data.title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer (Ruby/React & TS)
data.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision?

Then, Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

Simultaneously, we support accounting firms by enabling them to spend less time on redundant and repetitive tasks and more time on advising and supporting their clients. Already, over 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and more than 6,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France! 🚀

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 6 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1100+ happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

HOW you will contribute to the company as a Senior Software Engineer?

As a Senior Software Engineer at Pennylane, your squad is your primary focus. You will contribute to building reliable, scalable and user-focused products, while helping the engineers around you grow and raising the quality of our technical execution. You will:

  • Understand and frame user and product problems, using your product knowledge to help your squad deliver simple, pragmatic and valuable solutions.

  • Lead significant technical deliveries within your squad, from understanding the problem to designing, implementing, testing and operating the solution in production.

  • Investigate and resolve complex production issues, using monitoring, observability and data analysis tools to identify root causes and prevent recurrence.

  • Design and evolve robust solutions, identifying performance, scalability and reliability opportunities and turning them into pragmatic technical improvements.

  • Bring strong expertise in at least one major part of our stack, while being able to join a new team and become autonomous on a high-impact initiative within a few weeks.

  • Improve engineering practices across the organization, through high-quality code reviews, pair programming, documentation, RFCs and the adoption of AI-assisted development without compromising software quality.

  • Act as a role model and a driver for other engineers, sharing knowledge, providing actionable feedback and helping the team continuously improve its technical skills and ways of working.

  • Collaborate effectively with other teams when needed, proactively unblocking technical topics and clearly communicating progress, risks, decisions and results to the relevant stakeholders.

  • Contribute to the Pennylane tech community, through technical content, onboarding, interviews, incident resolution, tech initiatives, meetups or other community-building activities.

 

🥇 You’re the right candidate if you…

  • Have strong hands-on experience with Ruby on Rails and React (at least 7-8 years)

  • Combine technical expertise with strong product and business understanding, enjoy solving complex problems and care deeply about your users.

  • Are a collaborative team player, communicate clearly and take ownership of delivering reliable, pragmatic solutions.

  • Like being challenged and solving complex problems (accounting is complex in Europe)

  • Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly

 
 

🎁 What we offer

  • 🏢 You'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

  • 🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 30 vacations days paid by Pennylane

  • 💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

  • 📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

  • 🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

  • ⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

  • 🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

  • 💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

  • 🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

  1. If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 13 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

  2. We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 
 

🤝Hiring process

  • You will first have a general chat with a Talent Acquisition Manager (30 min)

  • You’ll then have a test-home assignment + a debriefing session with two of our software engineers (1 hour)

  • You’ll have a last culture-fit discussion with two people from our tech leadership (1 h)

 

We make sure we move fast ; you can expect the recruitment process with us to last between 15 and 25 days in total.

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment. We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

 

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información

data.description:
Why this role exists

At Pennylane, SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) are central to making our product easier to discover and understand, while helping us reach new customers.

We are looking for an SEO & AI Content Specialist to work closely with our SEO Manager and the wider Growth team. Your mission will be to produce, improve and scale high-quality content that drives non-branded organic traffic and conversions, while embedding AI thoughtfully into the way we work.

This role is for someone who enjoys writing, structuring, optimising, measuring and iterating. You are curious about the evolution of search and eager to explore how people discover products through search engines and AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Perplexity.

🌍 What is Pennylane?

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and enable accountants to focus on advising their clients.

A few figures that illustrate our scale and ambition:

💻 More than 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane.

🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 More than 1,100 Pennylaners work across the company, representing more than 25 nationalities.

💰 More than €400 million raised since launch.

🌍 A remote-friendly, international culture as we continue to grow across Europe.

What you’ll do

You will work closely with our SEO Manager and the wider Growth team and :

Build AI-powered content workflows

  • Use AI to accelerate research, outlining, first drafts and content optimisation, while maintaining a high editorial standard.

  • Design repeatable workflows, including briefs, quality checklists, templates and editorial guidelines.

  • Help scale content production efficiently without compromising relevance, accuracy or clarity.

Produce and optimise high-value SEO content

  • Write, update and improve SEO content, including articles, pillar pages and landing pages, to generate non-branded organic traffic and conversions.

  • Run continuous optimisation initiatives, including content refreshes, consolidation, internal linking and on-page improvements.

  • Build an understanding of the questions and prompts prospects use in AI-powered discovery tools.

  • Adapt content to help ensure Pennylane is accurately understood and discoverable across emerging AI search journeys.

  • Test content formats, structures and optimisation approaches that improve visibility in AI-generated answers — without compromising the experience for human readers.

  • Share learnings and contribute to shaping Pennylane’s evolving SEO and GEO playbook.

Make decisions with data

  • Monitor and prioritise work based on SEO performance signals, including visibility, rankings, impressions, clicks, CTR, organic traffic and conversions.

  • Translate data into concrete, actionable recommendations.

  • Run experiments, measure their impact and iterate quickly and rigorously.

What you bring

  • You have initial, meaningful hands-on experience in SEO, ideally with published content you can share.

  • You enjoy improving content and are motivated by the challenge of turning a good page into a high-performing one.

  • You take a pragmatic, data-informed approach: you form hypotheses, test them, measure outcomes and improve.

  • You already use AI tools in your day-to-day workflow and are excited to deepen your practice.

  • You have a sharp eye for structure, clarity, accuracy and editorial quality.

  • You are comfortable working in a fast-moving, collaborative environment and know how to focus on the initiatives with the greatest business impact.

🛠️ Tools and environment

You will work with tools such as Meteoria, Profound, Google Search Console, GA4, Semrush, Contentful and Notion.

What you can expect

  • A role with real room to propose, structure and improve how SEO works at Pennylane.

  • The opportunity to develop expertise at the intersection of SEO, content, GEO and AI.

  • A demanding and supportive team that values execution, learning and sound judgement.

  • A direct and visible impact on organic acquisition and conversion.

  • A remote-friendly working environment, with access to home-office equipment, coworking options where relevant and regular opportunities to meet teammates in person.

  • Benefits that support flexibility, wellbeing, connection and growth. These may vary depending on your country, contract type and role.

This role can be based in Paris on a hybrid basis, or remotely from anywhere in France.

data.title: Head of People Partnering & Development
data.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1300 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 300,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Accompagne la croissance de Pennylane en faisant travailler ensemble les HRBPs et le People Development

Pennylane est une scale-up fintech de 1 200 collaborateurs, présente en France, en Allemagne et en Espagne. Dans un contexte de forte croissance, d’expansion européenne et de transformation des métiers par l’IA, nous recrutons notre futur·e Head of People Partnering & Development.

Rattaché·e à la VP People, tu travailleras au plus près du COMEX et des leaders de l’entreprise.

Ta mission

Ta mission sera d’accompagner la croissance de Pennylane en faisant travailler ensemble deux disciplines complémentaires :

  • les HRBPs, qui accompagnent les équipes, les managers et les organisations au plus près des enjeux business ;

  • le People Development, qui porte le développement des compétences, la performance, les career paths, la gestion des talents et les programmes managers.

Tu veilleras à connecter ces expertises afin de proposer une approche People cohérente, internationale et directement alignée avec les priorités business.

Tes principales responsabilités

Stratégie People et accompagnement du business

  • Construire et piloter la roadmap commune HRBP et People Development ;

  • accompagner les enjeux organisationnels liés à la croissance et à l’internationalisation ;

  • conseiller et challenger les leaders sur leurs enjeux d’organisation, de management et de talents ;

  • développer une approche People fondée sur la donnée et l’anticipation ;

  • suivre les indicateurs clés : turnover, engagement, performance, capacité organisationnelle et développement des compétences.

Coordination internationale

  • Garantir une approche cohérente entre la France, l’Allemagne et l’Espagne ;

Tu as déjà structuré une fonction RH ou HRBP, recruté et développé une équipe, travaillé avec des dirigeants et accompagné une organisation en croissance. Une expérience internationale et une première pratique de l’IA dans un contexte RH seront particulièrement appréciées.

Ce qui fera la différence

Tu combines :

data.title: Product Manager (Protocol)
data.description:
About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Location

Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team).

 

Role

Morpho's Protocol team is evolving the core lending infrastructure that powers products and markets across the ecosystem. As the number of opportunities, integrations, and protocol initiatives grows, the team needs clear product direction on what to build, why it matters, and how to sequence the work.

This role will work with Morpho’s protocol team to shape product strategy and guide execution. You will turn the needs of users and ecosystem partners into a focused roadmap, work closely with protocol and engineering teams to shape solutions, and drive improvements from discovery through launch and adoption. You will operate at the intersection of deeply technical systems, financial markets, and a fast-moving ecosystem.

 

Responsibilities

  • Own the roadmap for Morpho's protocol team, defining the highest-impact problems to solve and sequencing opportunities against company goals, user needs, technical constraints, and ecosystem dynamics.

  • Build and run a continuous discovery process with curators, distributors, integrators, developers, and other protocol users to understand their workflows, pain points, and emerging needs.

  • Translate user and market insights into clear product requirements, decision frameworks, and success criteria that help protocol and engineering teams move quickly with strong rationale.

  • Partner closely with protocol, engineering, research, security, legal, solutions, partnerships, and marketing to take initiatives from early exploration through design, implementation, audit, launch, and adoption.

  • Evaluate product and technical tradeoffs, including when to extend the protocol, improve surrounding infrastructure, enable partners, or deliberately avoid adding complexity.

  • Define and track the signals that show whether protocol initiatives are working, combining quantitative data with ecosystem feedback to guide iteration and future investment.

  • Communicate product direction, decisions, tradeoffs, and release implications clearly to internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Improve how product decisions are made and documented as Morpho and its protocol ecosystem scale.

 

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days

You understand Morpho's protocol, development and release process, current roadmap, and the rationale behind the major initiatives in flight. You have built relationships across protocol, engineering, research, security, and go-to-market teams, and have started speaking with key curators, distributors, integrators, and developers.

 

First 3 months

You have established a clear, prioritized view of the most important protocol problems and opportunities. The roadmap reflects explicit tradeoffs, user evidence, technical constraints, and measurable outcomes. You have driven at least one meaningful initiative from discovery into execution and proactively keep stakeholders aligned on decisions and changes.

 

First 6 months

You have shipped a meaningful protocol improvement and can show how it advanced user or business outcomes. Product, protocol, and engineering teams have stronger shared context on what to build and why. You consistently identify important user needs, ecosystem shifts, and roadmap conflicts early, and have improved Morpho's product discovery and decision-making process.

 

Must Have Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years building technical products in complex or fast-changing environments.

  • Proven track record taking products or major features from ambiguous problem spaces through launch and iteration.

  • Strong technical fluency, with the ability to reason about system design and constraints, engage deeply with engineers and researchers, and translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

  • Excellent product judgment: you can distinguish important user problems from requests, make principled tradeoffs, and focus teams on the work with the greatest impact.

  • Strong user discovery and synthesis skills, with the ability to uncover needs across different user types and turn incomplete or conflicting inputs into clear direction.

  • Experience leading cross-functional work without relying on formal authority.

  • Ability to define success, use quantitative and qualitative evidence, and adapt direction as new information emerges.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, especially in an async environment.

  • Comfort creating clarity and driving decisions in highly ambiguous contexts.

  • Strong ownership and autonomy: you act without waiting to be told.

  • Team-first mindset, low ego.

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience in crypto, DeFi, traditional finance, or fintech.

  • Familiarity with lending markets, smart contracts, or permissionless protocols.

  • Experience shipping products with significant security, audit, regulatory, or governance considerations.

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

Your mission

At the end of your first year, you will have built a system in which our SDRs spend zero time on bad leads and 100% of their time on high-intent, well-qualified, properly enriched prospects.

You own the GTM infrastructure end-to-end. You sit at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, and Data. You report to the Head of RevOps, your main "client" is the Sales team.

This is an A to Z hands-on role. You define the strategy, build the workflows, run them, iterate.

 

Responsibilities

Pipeline Generation & Qualification

  • Design and maintain automated lead sourcing workflows (Clay, Apollo, Pharow, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.)

  • Build enrichment pipelines: firmographics, intent signals, tech stack, hiring activity

  • Define ICP scoring models and qualification criteria

  • Reduce SDR time spent on prospecting, give them lists they can act on immediately

GTM Tooling & Automation

  • Own the outbound stack: sequencing tools, enrichment tools, data providers

  • Build and maintain integrations between tools (CRM, enrichment, outreach, tracking)

  • Automate manual tasks: list building, data deduplication, routing, assignment

CRM & Data Hygiene

  • Keep the pipeline clean: right stages, right fields, right owners

  • Instrument touchpoints (emails, calls, LinkedIn, demos) in the CRM

  • Monitor data completeness; kill dead weight in the funnel

  • Map the SDR workflow end-to-end: where is time wasted, where does quality drop

  • First enrichment pipeline running in production

3 months

  • Enrichment coverage >80% on key signals (industry, headcount, tech stack, intent)

  • Outbound stack rationalized and documented

  • Pipeline dashboards live and trusted

6–12 months

  • GTM infrastructure that scales without adding headcount

  • SDRs spending <20% of time on list building / data ops

  • Measurable improvement in SQL rate and pipeline coverage

  • Company ready to scale outbound x3 with the same tooling

This role is for you if

  • 2–6 years in RevOps, Sales Ops, BizOps, Growth Ops in a SaaS / startup that scaled

  • Very strong with tools and wants to build from the ground up (CRM, spreadsheets, automation)

  • Structured thinker, you prioritize your task according to the impact on your yearly mission : scale sales and attain 10M in ARR.

  • You're structured, pragmatic, and execution-driven

Benefits

Recruitment process

1️⃣ Discovery call (30 min) with our Talent Acquisition Manager

2️⃣ Hiring Manager interview (45 min) with Robin, Head of Revops

3️⃣ Case study (1hr) with Alexandre, and Robin

3️⃣ Culture / founder fit (1hr) with Eliott, CEO and/or Hugo, CTO + coffee with the team

4️⃣ Reference check

5️⃣ Offer ! 🎉

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Responsibilities

  • Occasionally support field test campaigns to help with on-site data collection.

Candidate Requirements

  • Baccalauréat (or equivalent); no specific prior qualification required.
