  • Comfortable using digital tools and following strict, well-defined project guidelines.

  • Ability to work consistently and reliably within a structured, process-driven environment.

  • Previous experience in data-labeling, annotation, or content-evaluation is a plus.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills.

  • Fluency in French required; English is a plus.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

data.title: Automated Testing Module Lead
data.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Automated Testing Module Lead, you take ownership of how Harmattan validates its autonomy and flight-software stack. Today, our software is validated mostly against real hardware, a process that consumes airframes, range time, and crew while sampling only a handful of nominal trajectories. The cases we actually build for, such as degraded GNSS, sensor dropout, electronic warfare, and multi-agent situations, are rarely reached economically that way. Your mission is to establish the scenario library, execution strategy, and interface bricks to turn our existing simulation platform into a fast, reliable, and continuous validation engine.

This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role. You inherit an active team of four engineers across Paris and Lausanne, with a target of around eight by mid-2027. Beyond leading the team, you become the technical authority on our scenario-based testing: defining what runs across SITL, HITL, and CI, holding critical technical boundaries with adjacent teams, and bridging the gap between simulation fidelity and real flight data.

What You Will Do

  • Team Leadership & Strategy: Take over, structure, and give a clear mandate to our existing team of four engineers, while building the case and the roadmap to scale the module to around eight by mid-2027.
    Scenario & Simulation Engineering: Drive the design of a versioned scenario library covering nominal, edge, off-nominal, and contested flight conditions, expanding into Monte Carlo and multi-agent testing, and bring a team with no prior simulation experience up that curve.

  • Execution Strategy & Gating: Establish what tests run across SITL, HITL, and CI, defining gating policies, telemetry capture, deterministic replay, and coverage analytics.

  • Interface & Boundary Ownership: Negotiate, then maintain, strong, written technical boundaries with Tooling (who provide the simulation platform) and co-ownership splits with Validation (who define acceptance criteria and own final sign-off).

  • Sim-to-Real Correlation: Correlate simulation models against real flight data to continuously measure and close the sim-to-real gap, ensuring green test gates reflect real-world flight readiness.

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years in automated testing, simulation-based validation, or test engineering for complex physical / hardware-in-the-loop systems (e.g., Autonomous Driving, Aerospace, Defense, Robotics).
    Scenario & Simulation Depth: Hands-on experience designing scenario-based test suites on a simulation platform and defining coverage that genuinely catches defects. This is the capability our current team lacks, and therefore the most valuable thing you can bring.

  • Technical Depth: Hands-on proficiency in Python, C++, Linux, Docker, and CI environments, with deep domain expertise in scenario design, SITL/HITL execution, and simulation tools.

  • Leadership & Ownership: Proven ability to step into an existing engineering team, establish immediate clarity, and manage distributed engineers (Paris and Lausanne) effectively**, including engineers more senior than you in years of experience**.

  • Validation Mindset: A rigorous, analytical approach to noisy physical metrics, false positives, and flaky test environments, instinctively questioning what a passing test proves.

  • Cross-Functional Diplomacy: Track record of defining and holding clear interfaces with platform providers and internal customer teams.
    Bonus: Background in defense/aerospace flight software, control systems, or experience closing sim-to-real fidelity gaps.

  • Location & Travel: Based in Paris or Lausanne, with travel between sites. Working-
    level English.

What We Offer

  • Immediate Impact: Take over an established mandate with an existing team and pre-built simulation platform, delivering test capability in weeks rather than building from scratch.

  • High System Scope: Own the entire scenario library and execution strategy across our autonomy stack.
    Direct Mission Impact: Build test pipelines that directly accelerate the deployment of resilient autonomous systems in real-world defense environments.
    Cross-Functional Ownership: Work closely with Tooling, Validation, GNC, Perception, and Embedded SW teams to shape the future of flight-software reliability.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

data.title: Technicien Qualité (Quality Technician)
data.description:
À propos

Harmattan AI est un acteur de nouvelle génération dans le secteur de la défense, spécialisé dans la conception de systèmes autonomes et évolutifs. En combinant ingénierie avancée, robotique et intelligence artificielle, nous développons des capacités opérationnelles pensées pour le terrain.

Notre croissance rapide reflète une ambition claire : équiper les forces armées avec des systèmes à la hauteur des enjeux actuels. Nous recherchons des profils prêts à s’engager dans un environnement technique exigeant, avec un fort sens de la mission et de l’impact.

 
 

Rôle

Nous recherchons un Technicien Qualité pour rejoindre notre bureau de Paris. En travaillant sur le terrain aux côtés des équipes d'ingénierie, de fabrication et de qualité, vous veillerez à ce que la qualité soit intégrée à nos produits, du prototype jusqu'à la livraison au client. Vous rapporterez au Responsable Qualité.

 
 

Responsabilités

Support à la fabrication de prototypes :

  • Fournir un support qualité lors de l'assemblage des prototypes, en veillant à ce que les constructions soient conformes aux plans, aux instructions de travail et aux spécifications.

  • Identifier et documenter les pièces non conformes, soutenir le traitement et les actions correctives aux côtés de l'équipe d'ingénierie.

  • Aider à définir les méthodes d'inspection et les critères d'acceptation pour les nouveaux composants.

 

Revue de premier article (FAI) :

  • Réaliser des revues de premier article sur les pièces de développement.

  • Préparer et maintenir les rapports FAI avec une traçabilité complète des résultats d'inspection.

  • Assurer le suivi des conclusions de la FAI et veiller à ce que les actions correctives soient clôturées avant la mise en production.

 

Mur Qualité – Produits en développement :

  • Gérer le point de contrôle du mur qualité, en vérifiant que chaque unité de développement répond aux critères définis avant de passer à la phase suivante.

  • Tenir à jour les registres du mur qualité et donner de la visibilité sur l'état des produits et les motifs de blocage.

  • Faire remonter les défauts récurrents à l'Ingénierie Qualité et à la Conception pour résolution.

 

Support après-vente et tri chez le client :

  • Participer aux activités de support après-vente, y compris l'inspection sur site et le tri des produits chez les clients si nécessaire.

  • Effectuer des contrôles visuels et dimensionnels pour identifier les unités non conformes, isoler les produits défectueux et documenter les résultats.

  • Agir en tant que représentant qualité sur site, assurant la liaison entre le client et les équipes internes pour résoudre efficacement les problèmes de qualité.

  • Remonter les observations du terrain au centre de développement pour piloter les actions correctives et l'amélioration des produits.

 

Système Qualité et Amélioration Continue :

  • Veiller à ce que les rapports d'inspection et de non-conformité soient correctement documentés dans les outils appropriés (Jira, Confluence ou QMS).

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration des processus d'inspection et des critères du mur qualité au fil du temps.

 

Prérequis

  • Diplôme technique en qualité, génie mécanique, fabrication ou domaine connexe.

  • Première expérience dans un rôle d'inspection qualité ou de qualité fabrication, idéalement dans les secteurs de l'aérospatiale, de la défense ou de la haute technologie.

  • Capacité à lire des dessins d'ingénierie et à utiliser les outils d'inspection standards (pieds à coulisse, micromètres, etc.).

  • La connaissance des processus de revue de premier article (FAI) est un plus.

  • Connaissance des normes ISO 9001 et EN 9100.

  • Minutieux, rigoureux et à l'aise pour travailler en atelier.

  • Esprit d'équipe et bonnes compétences en communication.

  • Bon niveau d'anglais ; disponibilité pour se déplacer sur les sites des clients si nécessaire.

  • Adhésion totale à la mission de Harmattan AI et volonté de s'investir pleinement pour soutenir notre croissance.

 

Nous avons hâte de découvrir comment vous pouvez aider à façonner l'avenir des systèmes de défense autonomes chez Harmattan AI.

This role sits at the intersection of internal transformation and external impact. The AI systems and workflows you build internally are increasingly becoming part of Bigblue's external story — shaping how we serve merchants, how our agents engage with them in-product, and how we turn our own operational learnings into time and money saved for the 600+ brands we serve.

You will work across disciplines as part builder, part data expert, part product manager, and part business-ops maven, co-developing the cutting edge of AI tooling for the Bigblue team and using it to drive massive change at high velocity. data.description:
💙 About Bigblue

E-commerce is booming — but independent brands still struggle to match the seamless logistics of giants like Amazon. At Bigblue, we're on a mission to change that. We help brands by democratizing best-in-class operations: scaling faster while delivering a five-star customer experience.

Since 2018, we've built a tech-driven logistics platform powering 500+ brands — from fast-growing DTC players to global names like MUJI, Aigle, and Cabaïa. With 110+ employees across Paris, Madrid, and London, our proprietary WMS (Warehouse Management System) Atlas, and a network of 7 warehouses across Europe, we're solving logistics challenges that others haven't dared to tackle — making fulfillment faster, smarter, and greener.

Backed by $20+M in funding and trusted by the next generation of e-commerce leaders, we're scaling rapidly — from 10 million orders in 2024 toward ambitious enterprise expansion. The journey ahead is bold, and we're looking for the right partner to help us lead the way.

📊 What data means for Bigblue

At Bigblue, data is the backbone of how we operate. Our data infrastructure — built on BigQuery and dbt, surfaced through Metabase — powers every operational decision: from tracking fulfillment performance across 7 warehouses to monitoring carrier service rates in real time. As we scale across Europe, our BI layer needs to scale with us.

The Ops Excellence team is at the heart of this challenge: translating raw warehouse and transportation data into reliable, structured, and accessible intelligence — so our operators, product teams, and executives can act fast and act right.


🚀 The role

Location: Paris — 7 rue Caumartin, 75009

Type: End-of-studies internship or gap year (SFE / césure)

Duration: 6 months

Start: ASAP

Bigblue is looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer Intern to join the Ops Excellence team.

This is a highly technical role at the intersection of data engineering and analytics. You won't just consume data — you'll help build the infrastructure that makes it accessible, reliable, and actionable for our entire Ops organization. This is a unique opportunity to work on real-scale, production-grade BI systems in a fast-moving logistics startup.


✍️ Our data challenges
  • Data pipeline development: Design, build, and maintain data pipelines that consolidate and transform raw warehouse and operational data into clean, structured datasets ready for analysis — using SQL, dbt, and our BigQuery data warehouse.
  • Dashboard & reporting infrastructure: Develop scalable BI solutions — datasets, reports, and Metabase dashboards — that give our Ops teams real-time visibility into fulfillment KPIs, warehouse performance, and service levels.
  • Data modeling & schema design: Create and manage data structures that are robust, well-documented, and easy for analysts across teams to use — applying best practices in schema design and data governance.
  • Automation & process improvement: Write secure, maintainable code that automates recurring reporting tasks and frees our analysts to focus on higher-value work. Identify opportunities to replace manual processes with scalable, engineered solutions.
  • Data quality & reliability: Troubleshoot data and pipeline issues, propose solutions, and take ownership of resolutions — ensuring that the numbers our teams rely on are always accurate and up to date.

    • 🙌 Your profile
  • Student in year 4 or 5 of an engineering school, computer science, statistics, or equivalent program
  • Strong SQL skills — able to write complex queries, optimize for performance, and model data from scratch
  • Familiarity with data engineering tools and concepts: dbt, BigQuery, ETL pipelines, data modeling
  • Experience with BI and visualization tools (Metabase, Looker, Power BI, or similar)
  • Python or another scripting language is a strong plus
  • You think in terms of systems: you care about code quality, reusability, and long-term maintainability
  • Curious and rigorous — you go deep to understand the data before trusting it
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, startup environment with evolving requirements
  • Fluency in English and French

    • 🎁 What we offer
  • 🍽️ Meal: €5 per working day (100% tax-exempt) + free meals at the office twice a week
  • 🐻 Health: Alan health insurance, 100% covered
  • 🚲 Transportation: Swile card with €42.50/month for transport
  • 🛍️ "Buy from our merchants" program: birthday, anniversary & end-of-year gifts from Bigblue brands
  • 💰 Compensation: €1,000/month
  • Brand new offices in Paris' largest tech hub (9th arrondissement)
  • MacBooks as standard, plus any equipment you need to do your best work

data.title: Head of Marketing & Lead Generation
data.description:
Who are we?

moka.care is a mental health solution for companies, with one mission in mind: nurturing healthy minds to foster healthy organizations.

We guide employees through individual and group therapy or coaching sessions.

Alongside we help HR teams to take care of their employees’ mental health on a daily basis.

Where we are currently: Since our creation in December 2019, more than 400 companies (L'Oreal, Spendesk, Qonto, Engie, Castalie, etc.) have joined moka.care, and we now have over 300,000 employees covered in France but also throughout the world!

We have raised 17,5 million euros and are 70 to help companies improve their mental well-being.

What we believe in? Excellence in care is our obsession.

Culture is not nice words we put on the walls, we have defined 4 tangible values to make this culture live: Team Play, Optimism, Ownership & Agility.


Why do we need you?

Moka.Care has built strong foundations in a rapidly evolving market. We are now looking for a marketing leader who can scale our growth and pipeline generation efforts, strengthen our commercial execution, improve go-to-market effectiveness and continue building a leading brand for HR and People teams.

Reporting to Guillaume d’Ayguesvives, co-founder, you will own Moka.Care’s global marketing strategy with a strong focus on pipeline generation, revenue impact and commercial performance.

You will lead a multidisciplinary team of 8 people organized across three main areas:

  • Brand, Awareness & Customer Enablement, led by a Brand & Product Marketing Lead
  • Lead Generation, Content & Sales Enablement
  • BDR Team, led by a BDR Team Lead

You will also work closely with the Revenue Operations team to ensure strong alignment between marketing performance, pipeline generation and revenue outcomes.

This role is designed for a performance-oriented marketing leader who combines strategic vision with operational excellence, and who knows how to build scalable growth systems in B2B environments.

What will you do?

Lead a high-performing marketing organization

  • Provide clear direction, prioritization and performance management across the team
  • Coach and develop managers and senior contributors
  • Stay closely involved in execution, funnel performance and operational priorities
  • Strengthen collaboration across Marketing, Sales, Customer, Product, Tech and Revenue Operations teams

Lead Moka.Care’s growth and pipeline generation

  • Define Moka.Care’s growth and lead generation priorities across inbound, outbound, paid acquisition and lifecycle marketing
  • Scale a predictable and efficient pipeline generation engine aligned with revenue objectives
  • Improve acquisition efficiency, funnel conversion and channel performance
  • Partner closely with Revenue Operations to strengthen marketing performance measurement, attribution and budget allocation decisions
  • Strengthen alignment and operating rhythms between Marketing, BDR and Sales teams
  • Lead and develop the BDR Team Lead to maximize outbound pipeline generation and performance

Drive commercial positioning & go-to-market effectiveness

  • Improve go-to-market effectiveness by strengthening the connection between marketing initiatives, commercial priorities and sales execution

  • Contribute to maximizing the commercial impact of new offers, campaigns and strategic initiatives

Act as a strategic thinking partner to our Brand & Product Marketing Lead to

  • Support thought leadership through public-facing opportunities and by building relationships with key influencers (HR leaders, scientific experts, industry communities, etc.)
  • Support brand awareness initiatives with creative campaign ideas and strong narratives
  • Protect consistency across brand, content and communication initiatives

You’re the ideal person if

  • You have 8+ years of experience in B2B marketing, including leadership roles (ideally marketing to HR and People Teams as core target personas)
  • You have a strong track record in demand generation, pipeline creation and revenue-focused marketing
  • You have experience leading or working closely with BDR/SDR teams and outbound pipeline generation
  • You are highly data-driven and comfortable working closely with funnel performance and GTM metrics
  • You combine strategic thinking with a strong operational mindset
  • You also have a strong brand sensibility and understand the importance of positioning and messaging

data.description:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Chez Doctrine, on grandit vite. Très vite. De l'organique (nouveaux produits, nouveaux pays) comme de l'externe : 5 boîtes rachetées en 3 ans.
Résultat en 2026 : près de 30 000 clients dans 5 pays : France, Allemagne, Italie, Luxembourg et Espagne. Et sur notre marché historique, la France, on est loin d'avoir fini de jouer.

Doctrine est le leader européen de l'IA juridique. Mais un juriste d'entreprise ne travaille pas comme un avocat, et un dirigeant n'a pas les mêmes attentes qu'un juriste du secteur public.

Le segment Corporate (juristes privés et publics, experts et dirigeants d'entreprises) a ses propres codes, ses propres enjeux. C'est là que tu entres en scène : faire décoller la croissance de Doctrine sur le Corporate France.

Ton objectif n°1 : faire grimper l'ARR de Doctrine sur le segment Corporate en France. Un rôle stratégique, au cœur de la machine Go-to-Market, qui touche tout le funnel : acquisition, activation, rétention (upsell, cross-sell inclus).

L'équipe que tu rejoins

Tu rejoins une équipe Growth de 4 personnes : ton futur manager, deux Growths sur les marchés internationaux et une personne sur le segment Avocat sur le marché français. En face, une vraie force de frappe commerciale que tu vas alimenter au quotidien : 10 BDR, 13 Account Executives et 6 Account Managers. Les leads que tu génères ont donc un terrain de jeu à la hauteur et ton impact se voit vite.

Le point de départ (plutôt sympa 👀)

  • Un modèle SaaS en forte croissance… et rentable (oui, les deux)
  • Un product market fit avec du momentum : près de 30 000 avocats et juristes déjà clients
  • Une équipe Go-to-Market (Marketing, RevenueOps & Sales) au top pour t'aider à dénicher de nouvelles poches de croissance
  • Une place de leader européen sur une des catégories les plus dynamique au monde : l'IA juridique
  • Une stack à la pointe et une bibliothèque de contenus déjà bien fournie pour dégainer sur les bons leviers et les objections de vente

Tes missions :

Au sein de l'équipe Growth, en collaboration avec les Sales Corporate et l’équipe marketing (PMM, Com, Event) tu passes tes journées à affûter le funnel sur le segment Corporate. Et surtout : tout est challengeable.

  • GTM Synch : animer les points réguliers avec l'équipe Sales Corporate pour définir avec eux, les priorités de campagnes en fonction des besoins terrain. Tu es le trait d'union entre le Growth et les Sales.
  • Outbound Lead Gen : dénicher les bons contacts pour les Sales et lancer les campagnes d'activation (enrichissement, automation, séquences, suivi des perfs).
  • Inbound Lead Gen : Aide au pilotage avec notre agence des campagnes sur Meta, LinkedIn et Google, pour générer un max de leads qualifiés.
  • Nurturing & customer education :
  • Bâtir et faire tourner les campagnes de nurturing sur des leads et contacts,
  • Épauler le Product Marketing sur les lancements produits et les campagnes d’usages à destination de nos utilisateurs,
  • Être le bras droit du marketing sur nos events, webinars et product launches.

    • Le profil qu'on recherche :

    Tu es la personne idéale si tu as envie d’avoir de l’impact, aimes avancer vite et tester de nouvelles approches aussi bien que maintenir des systèmes de campagnes en placer. Et évidemment, tu as à coeur de sortir un copywriting qui poussera à l’action.

    Pour le reste ? Pas besoin d'être un marketeur pur jus. Ops, RevOps, Tech, tous les chemins mènent au Growth. Ce qui compte vraiment : l'envie d'apprendre et de mettre les mains dans le cambouis pour faire grandir Doctrine.

    Hard skills

  • L'IA, c'est ton copilote : ce poste se travaille à 100 % avec l'IA. Production de campagnes, copywriting, analyse, automatisation. Un réflexe quotidien.
  • À l'aise (les mains dedans) sur les outils de marketing automation, sales engagement et CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Intercom, Lemlist…)
  • Tu comprends comment la data circule entre les outils pour créer, challenger et optimiser les parcours clients & prospects
  • Une vraie plume pour le copywriting et l'envie de comprendre ce qui fait vibrer notre cible (juristes, experts, dirigeants)
  • L'envie de construire des stratégies qui durent, pas juste du quick & dirty
  • Un peu d'analytique dans les veines (le SQL est un joli bonus)

    • Soft skills

  • Bon communicant, et tu sais faire parler la data pour trancher
  • Créatif·ve, curieux·se de la psychologie utilisateur pour imaginer des programmes qui marquent
  • Team player : tu navigues dans les équipes transverses et tu comprends les enjeux de chacun pour proposer les meilleurs plans d'action
  • 2 à 3 ans d’expérience, idéalement dans un environnement tech.
  • Maitrise de l’anglais fortement recommandée car régulièrement utilisée en interne

    • Notre stack 🛠️
    Salesforce · HubSpot · Outreach · Intercom · Lemlist · Mixpanel · Google Analytics · Metabase · Zapier/Make

    Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

    🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

     

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

data.title: Growth Marketing - Germany 🇩🇪
data.description:
Our Mission ⚖️

At Doctrine, we're building Europe's leading legal AI platform.

Our belief? Law shouldn't be slowed down by repetitive tasks. It should be augmented by a specialised AI, designed to understand, analyse and produce legal reasoning at the highest standard.

Our ambition? To help legal professionals work with greater reliability, efficiency and peace of mind, through a single, comprehensive and secure platform.

Today, 27,000 legal professionals across five countries (France, Italy, Germany, Spain and Luxembourg) trust us to do just that.

Our growth is guided by a clear approach: a global vision, grounded in a deep understanding of local specificities.

Behind this ambition, a team of around 250 people, united around one goal: supporting lawyers and legal professionals at every stage of their work, from research to drafting.

And we're just getting started.


We grow fast. Really fast. Organically (new products, new countries) and through acquisitions: 5 companies snapped up in 3 years, including a fresh one in Spain. The result in 2026: close to 30,000 customers across 5 countries. The German market? It just blew out its first birthday candle.

Doctrine is the European leader in legal AI. But a German lawyer doesn't work like a French one, and in-house counsel in Berlin don't have quite the same needs as their Paris counterparts. Every market has its own playbook. That's where you come in: putting Doctrine's growth in Germany into overdrive.

 

The team you're joining

A Growth team of 4: your future manager, one Growth on Italy, two on France. We're hunting for the 5th avenger to complete the squad and take full ownership of the German market. On the other side of the table, a team of full-funnel Account Executives ready to turn the leads you generate into wins.

The starting point (pretty sweet, honestly 👀)

  • A high-growth SaaS model, and a profitable one (yes, both)
  • Rock-solid product-market fit with real momentum: close to 30,000 lawyers and legal professionals already on board
  • A top-tier Go-to-Market team (Marketing, RevenueOps & Sales) to help you uncover new pockets of growth
  • An established spot as the European leader of a category we helped invent: legal AI
  • A cutting-edge tooling stack and a loaded content library to fire on the right levers and shut down objections

Your missions

Inside the Growth team, hand in hand with Sales, PMM and Product, you spend your days sharpening the German funnel, a mix of inbound and outbound. And the best part: everything is open to challenge. Got a better idea? We're all ears.

  • Internationalization: design and roll out local campaigns built for the codes and expectations of the German market (no copy-paste from France).
  • Inbound Lead Gen: team up with our agency to build campaigns that hit hard on Meta, LinkedIn and Google, and pull in as many qualified leads as possible.
  • Outbound Lead Gen: pinpoint the right contacts for the sales teams and fire up activation campaigns (enrichment, automation, sequences, performance tracking).
  • Nurturing: build and run nurturing campaigns on our leads, plus product-usage campaigns with existing customers, to max out conversion and retention.
  • Field Marketing & Product Growth: back the PMM team on product launches and be field marketing's right hand on our events, webinars and product launches.

The profile we're looking for

You're our 5th avenger if you're not afraid to build campaigns day in, day out and copywriting is your thing (better yet, you love it). And, of course: you need to speak German.

For the rest? No need to be a pure-bred marketer. Ops, RevOps, Tech, all roads lead to Growth. What really counts: the drive to learn and to get your hands dirty to help Doctrine grow.

Hard skills

  • AI is your copilot: this role runs 100% with AI, campaign production, copywriting, analysis, automation. A daily reflex, not a gimmick.
  • Hands-on experience with marketing automation, sales engagement and CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Intercom, Lemlist…).
  • A solid grasp of how data flows between tools, to build, challenge and optimize customer and prospect journeys.
  • A real appetite for copywriting and for understanding what makes our audience tick.
  • A drive to build strategies that last, not just quick & dirty wins.
  • Analytical skills (SQL is a nice bonus).

Soft skills

  • Fluent or native German, non-negotiable: you write and think your campaigns in the language of the market. Professional English also required.
  • Strong communicator who lets the data do the talking when it's time to decide.
  • Creative and curious about user psychology, to design programs that leave a mark.
  • A real team player: you move through cross-functional teams and get everyone's stakes to land the best action plans.

Our stack 🛠️

Salesforce · HubSpot · Outreach · Intercom · Lemlist · Mixpanel · Google Analytics · Metabase · Zapier/Make

What's in it for you ☀️

🏡 A flexible remote work policy, allowing up to three days of remote work per week (depending on your team).

🌴 A flexible leave policy

🌱 Real internal mobility opportunities

🏄‍♂️ Regular team events

📚 A genuine focus on individual and collective learning, with a €750 annual budget for any training related to your role, plus team-wide and company-wide training sessions

🏋️‍♀️ A Gymlib subscription for sports and wellness activities

🧘 Free access to the Moka.care mental health support platform, including up to 6 individual sessions per year

👩‍⚕️ Health insurance with Alan

🍱🚲 A Swile card for meal vouchers and sustainable mobility allowance (€66.60/month)

💡 Discounts and perks via our Works Council (CSE) on the Happypal platform

🍏 Brand new Apple equipment

Our values 🤝

At Doctrine, our 4 values guide us every day as we work to move things forward.

Challenge the status quo: we champion bold ideas that drive change across an entire industry.

Liberty and responsibility: we encourage autonomy, individual impact and ownership.

Knowledge is power: information is at the heart of Doctrine's mission, and we constantly strive to grow.

Release early, release often and listen to your customers: we believe in the power of iteration and in constantly listening to our market, our customers and their challenges.

 Our hiring process 🚀

  1. A 30-min intro call with one of our Talent Acquisition Managers to understand your career goals and walk you through what we're building at Doctrine.
  2. A 1-hour conversation with your future manager to dive into the role, team scope and answer all your questions.
  3. One or two technical assessments to evaluate your skills in practice.
  4. An office visit including: lunch with 3 people from different teams to give you a feel for your future colleagues; a values conversation to share our vision; and a meeting with our CEO, Guillaume.

(The process can be adapted to fit your personal and professional constraints if needed.)

Ladies, go ahead and apply!

Research shows that women in particular tend not to apply for a role when they don't meet every single requirement. To put your mind at ease: this job description is a guide, nothing more.

If Doctrine interests you, we'd love to hear from you!

Diversity & inclusion

All our roles are open to people with disabilities. Feel free to bring it up at any point during the process. We're committed to putting in place whatever adjustments are needed to ensure a working environment that works for everyone.

data.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
data.description:
Job Title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
Type: Full-time
Location: Paris 
 
What about us?
 
Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas.
 
At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents.
 
By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide.
 
Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀 
 
The Role

We have signed our largest customer to date: a European automotive dealer group operating hundreds of agencies across several countries, with thousands of daily users moving their entire used-vehicle operation onto INFINIT.

As the Enterprise Customer Success Manager — Dealer Groups, based in Paris, you own that relationship. Not as one of ten logos in a portfolio — this is one account, and you go deep into it. You will know their network, their brands, their agency managers and their numbers better than anyone at INFINIT, and you will be the name they think of when they think of us.

The role has two chapters. The first is the migration: you are embedded with the pilot agencies while we tailor the product, and you then own the deployment programme for the whole network — the setup of every agency and the rollout, country by country, on a committed date. Our project leads own the integration and the custom development; getting hundreds of agencies configured, trained and live is yours. The second chapter is the one that lasts: once we are live, this is pure enterprise account management at depth — adoption across thousands of users, the group's commercial results, the renewal, and the expansion of INFINIT across everything else they do.

If your idea of account management is quarterly reviews and a shared inbox, this will not suit you. You will spend real time in dealerships.


What do we want to achieve together?

First chapter — land it (through the migration)

  • Be embedded with the pilot agencies. On site, in the showroom, next to used-vehicle managers, sales advisors and call-centre agents. You learn how they genuinely work — not how it was described in a meeting room — and you make the pilot succeed on their terms.

  • Own the deployment programme. You build and run the rollout plan for hundreds of agencies: sequencing, setup and configuration, user provisioning, training, go-live criteria, hypercare, and the migration tracker the group's leadership reads every week. This is genuine programme ownership — you hold the plan, not someone else's.

  • Lead through the group's regional supervisors. Your closest allies on the ground are the group's regional supervisors — their people, not ours, covering each part of the network. You set the plan, the cadence and the standards with them, and you make the programme theirs to succeed at, in an organisation where nobody reports to you. On our side, you can draw on INFINIT's Operations Agents for setup, configuration and data work.

  • Run the product feedback loop. You are the single channel between the group and our Product & Engineering teams. You separate a genuine platform gap from a habit dressed up as a requirement, write requirements engineers can act on, and hold a prioritised backlog the customer recognises as theirs.

  • Protect the date without breaking trust. Hundreds of agencies migrate inside a single quarter with a hard cut-over. You are the one who sees the risk early, says so, and gets it fixed.

    • Second chapter — grow it (the long game)

  • Drive adoption and value, agency by agency. You track usage across the network, spot the sites that are behind, understand why, and fix it. You know which agencies love us and which ones are quietly not using us — and you never learn that from a dashboard alone.

  • Be the group's business partner, not their vendor contact. You understand their stock turn, their margin per vehicle, their lead conversion. You bring them insight they don't have, and you are credible with agency managers, with the DSI and with general management alike.

  • Own the commercial outcome. Retention and renewal of our largest contract, plus the expansion of INFINIT across the group — above all the deployment of our AI agents into their day-to-day operations.

  • Turn one account into a model. What you learn becomes INFINIT's enterprise dealer-group playbook.


    • What do you need to be successful in this role?

  • 5+ years in enterprise account management in B2B SaaS, owning a small number of large, complex, multi-site customers — not a broad portfolio. You have carried retention and growth on an account that mattered to your company.

  • You have run a multi-site deployment, not inherited one post-go-live. A rollout you personally planned and delivered: the sequencing, the readiness criteria, the training plan, the tracker, the escalation path. We will want the detail — how many sites, what broke, how you held the date.

  • You can lead people who don't report to you. The group's regional supervisors and site managers on one side; INFINIT's Operations Agents, Product and Support teams on the other. You set direction through clarity and credibility rather than authority.

  • Genuinely hands-on. You are comfortable being the most operational person in the room, doing training sessions yourself, sitting with end users for a full day, and being reachable when a site has a problem.

  • Credible in two very different rooms. A technical and contractual conversation with a group IT director, and a full day in a dealership with a used-vehicle manager who has no interest in software. Neither is a performance for you.

  • Product instinct. You are genuinely interested in how the product works, you can arbitrate configuration versus build, and you are comfortable telling a customer no and explaining why.

  • Native-level French and fluent English. A further European language is a strong advantage.

  • Willingness to be in the field. Expect roughly one to two days a week travelling across France during the migration phases, plus regular travel to the group's other European markets, and continued field presence afterwards.

  • Automotive retail experience is a real plus — used vehicles, DMS, stock, pricing, listings, leads — but curiosity for it is the non-negotiable part. You will spend a lot of time on the subject of used cars.


    • What will you find working at INFINIT?
  • Competitive Salary and Equity: We offer highly competitive salaries and a stake in our success with share options because we're building this together.

data.title: Responsable Systèmes d'Information & Outils internes H/F
data.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers.

Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d’utilisateurs dans 98 pays, nos solutions s’imposent aujourd’hui comme des références sur le   marché :

N2F : gestion des dépenses professionnelles (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs)

Keeple : gestion RH du quotidien (congés, absences, temps de travail)

L’entreprise est en forte croissance avec une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Pourquoi ce poste ?

Notre écosystème d’outils s’est construit progressivement avec la croissance de l’entreprise. Il est aujourd’hui riche mais encore insuffisamment structuré :

  • des outils qui ne communiquent pas toujours efficacement entre eux

  • des données encore partiellement silotées

  • certains processus insuffisamment maîtrisés

  • un potentiel d’automatisation et d’usage de l’IA encore peu exploité

Certaines briques sont déjà portées en interne, mais de manière partielle ou trop manuelle.

Nous créons ce poste pour structurer durablement le SI, fiabiliser les flux et accompagner la montée en maturité de l’organisation.

Ton rôle

Rattaché au CTO, tu interviens de manière transverse sur l’ensemble de l’entreprise.

Le poste est volontairement hybride : à la fois stratégique et opérationnel. L’objectif n’est pas uniquement de piloter, mais de comprendre, structurer et mettre en œuvre.

Tu travailles en lien étroit avec le CODIR et les équipes métiers.

Tes responsabilités

Structuration du SI et des flux

  • Cartographier les outils et les flux existants

  • Identifier les points de friction et les incohérences

  • Structurer la circulation de la donnée (clients, prospects, finance…)

  • Concevoir et faire évoluer les intégrations entre les systèmes

L’objectif est d’éliminer les silos et de fiabiliser les échanges de données.

Reprise en main des sujets critiques

  • Monter en compétence sur les outils clés, notamment la facturation

  • Fiabiliser les processus existants

  • Réduire la dépendance aux tâches manuelles via l’automatisation

Pilotage de l’écosystème outils

  • Recueillir et challenger les besoins des équipes métiers

  • Définir une logique cohérente d’évolution du SI

  • Arbitrer entre amélioration de l’existant et mise en place de nouveaux outils

  • Piloter les projets SI de bout en bout

Management d’équipe

  • Encadrer une équipe de 3 développeurs

  • Prioriser les sujets en fonction des enjeux business

  • Structurer le backlog et assurer l’alignement avec les besoins de l’entreprise

Développement des usages IA

  • Identifier des cas d’usage concrets avec les équipes

  • Prototyper et déployer des solutions

  • Accompagner l’adoption


Ce que tu apportes

  • 6 à 10 ans d’expérience en SI applicatif, Business Systems ou équivalent

  • Une expérience en environnement SaaS (idéalement dans des structures de 200 à 500 personnes)

  • Une bonne maîtrise des problématiques d’intégration et de flux de données (API, webhooks, synchronisation)

  • Une capacité à comprendre, challenger et structurer un écosystème d’outils dans sa globalité

  • Une expérience avec des outils d’automatisation (Make, Zapier, n8n ou équivalent)

  • Une expérience en management d’équipe technique

  • Une capacité à travailler de manière transverse avec des interlocuteurs métiers variés

Ce poste n’est pas adapté si

  • tu es très orienté(e) grands groupes avec des SI lourds et peu agiles

  • tu recherches un rôle purement stratégique sans implication opérationnelle

  • ton expertise est principalement orientée sécurité (ce périmètre est couvert par un autre rôle)

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Une entreprise SaaS solide avec des fondamentaux rares, qui combine croissance soutenue et rentabilité

  • Tu arrives à un moment clé où beaucoup reste à structurer pour passer un cap, avec déjà une base existante

  • Une proximité avec la direction, un bon niveau d’autonomie et des cycles de décision rapides

  • Un rôle avec un impact visible rapidement, aussi bien sur les équipes que sur les résultats

  • Des sujets variés et concrets, entre structuration du SI et montée en gamme

  • Une équipe accessible, impliquée et orientée résultats

Poste basé à Montagnat (01) avec présence attendue 2 jours par semaine.

data.title: Satcom Consultant Engineer
data.description:
Are you a highly-motivated, technically-minded, critical thinker with 3-5 years of experience in consulting, looking for your next challenge? Join a leading consulting player in the booming space industry!
 
The Technology Consulting business line is the technology and operations’ arm of the Novaspace group. It has more than 50 customers in developed and emerging space markets, in all regions of the world and across the space ecosystem, including satellite operators, governmental and international organizations (Space agencies, Defense agencies, regulatory bodies, etc.), financial institutions (private banks, commercial banks, private equity funds, etc.),insurance brokers and insurance companies.
 
Novaspace Technology has developed expertise and know-how around a portfolio of services and capabilities covering the complete lifecycle of a space project, from feasibility studies and project development to operations and training support.
 
We are looking for motivated consultant satcom engineers to support different consulting missions: technical studies (e.g. State of the art or innovation analysis), feasibility analysis (comparison of several high level designs) and procurement (RFP & comparative analysis of industrial proposals) of different satcom systems (LEO, MEO & GEO).
 
If this sounds like you, then read on!

Who we are looking for
  • You have a good technical knowledge of at least one of the topics mentioned above.
  • You like to learn and improve quickly on technical concepts and actors to grasp the technological and application challenges.
  • You have a real team spirit, and you are rigorous.
  • You can summarize information from a complex report to a short presentation or produce a single intelligible content from multiple sources.
  • You are proficient in writing reports and presentations with a high level of quality.
  • You are a good communicator, able to present content with ease in front of an audience.
  • You are well organized, with a good level of autonomy to perform your tasks in cooperation with your leader (using collaborative and simple project management tools).

    • Primary role and responsibilities
  • Support (and eventually lead) the missions above mentioned which can include data collection and analysis, technical surveys of upcoming technologies and standards, support to system design analysis and generation of technical reports and presentations in accordance with project requirements.
  • Contribute to (and eventually lead) the management of engineering studies (development of the technical and project management documents, determination of the necessary resources, communication with stakeholders, management of contracts). Ensure that they meet technical, programmatic, quality and cost objectives.
  • Participate in writing consulting proposals or technical reports.

    • Desired skills & experience
  • MSc in space engineering with a major preferably in telecommunications (incl. software development will be a plus).
  • 3 to 5 years of experience within the space sector preferably in satcom but could be EO or other.
  • Satellite communications expertise including satellite link budget analysis , and or development of payload architecture is an asset,
  • In addition to strong technical capabilities, you have good presentation and interpersonal skills (soft skills) as the position requires daily collaboration with other Novaspace engineers and international customers.
  • Ability to travel, as you will be able to work at our clients' sites or operations anywhere in the world: Europe, Middle East, Asia, the Americas, etc
  • Fluent in English
  • EU citizen or permanent EU residence/work permit
    • About Novaspace
     
    Novaspace is the global leading consulting firm in the space sector. With a robust 40-year legacy of expertise in guiding private companies and government entities through strategic decisionmaking processes, Novaspace offers end-to-end consulting services, from project strategy definition to implementation, providing data-led perspectives on critical issues. Our mission is to empower clients with strategic and technical insights, enabling them to navigate and seize new opportunities within the rapidly evolving space sector. As a privately owned and fully independent organization, Novaspace presents an expanded portfolio of services, featuring combined expertise in management and technology consulting, top-tier executive summits, and market intelligence. Trusted by 1,200 clients in over 60 countries, Novaspace has offices strategically located in Brussels, Montreal, Munich, Paris, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo, Toulouse, and Washington D.C. Working at Novaspace will give you the opportunity to boost your career in the space/consulting industry where our role is to support the decision-makers by providing them the highest quality support in everything we do: consulting, market intelligence, training and summits. 
     
    Only Applications containing a Motivation Letter and a CV in English will be considered.

data.title: Outbound GTM Engineer
data.description:
Didomi helps organizations collect, store, and leverage user choices across multiple channels, increasing precision in marketing and advertising operations and building trust through transparent data practices.

Through a comprehensive software platform and premium support services, Didomi enables large corporations to optimize the collection and activation of user choice data, monitor vendor and tracker activity, and reduce compliance risk under global privacy regulations.

Following the 2025 acquisitions of Addingwell and Sourcepoint, Didomi has strengthened its end-to-end capabilities across consent, preferences, and data activation, bringing together server-side tagging and privacy technology to deliver experiences that improve performance, trust, and loyalty.

Active in 35 countries, Didomi supports over 2,000 clients across various sectors, including some of the world’s largest corporations, in building revenue-driving operations based on reliable and robust user choice data.

For more information, please visit www.didomi.io

The role

We are hiring a Outbound GTM Engineer to design, industrialize and run the engine behind our outbound acquisition. This is an individual contributor role, reporting directly the Revenue Operations Director working closely with the CRO, with a priority mandate to accelerate customer acquisition and expansion at the Group Level across North America and EMEA. You will own the data, the signals, the scoring and the automation that make our outreach sharper, faster and more scientific, and you will feed Sales with the best possible pipeline.

What you'll do

  • Clean and structure our TAM across all markets: deduplication, enrichment and segmentation.

  • Deliver exceptional-quality outreach data that every rep can rely on.

  • Centralize all buying and intent signals, and score every prospect and customer in the base.

  • Accelerate new business, expansion and cross-sell by feeding Sales the best data and intent, with a priority on Addingwell.

  • Automate the full lead workflow end to end: capture, enrichment, deduplication, scoring, routing and sequencing.

  • Improve prospection workflows across the main channels (email, LinkedIn, cold calling).

  • Build and scale a methodical, multichannel outbound machine (ICP, sequences, A/B testing, personalization at scale).

  • Improve inbound lead scoring and reactivate marketing-sourced leads into pipeline.

  • Track performance rigorously and iterate relentlessly on conversion rates.

What we're looking for

  • Outbound track record: you have built an outbound machine from scratch and can quantify its impact (pipeline, ARR, conversion rates).

  • Lead workflow automation: you automate capture, enrichment, scoring, routing and sequencing, and you are comfortable with ops tools, APIs, webhooks and no-code / low-code.

  • Tooling mastery: hands-on with ZoomInfo, lemlist and a modern CRM.

  • Data and signal mindset: you turn intent signals into prioritized, high-quality lists.

  • Copywriting and sequencing: messaging that converts, tested at scale.

  • International reach: fluent English and the ability to operate across North America and EMEA.

  • A scientific, automation-first operator: systematic, analytical, resilient, and fully accountable for your numbers.

Nice to have

  • Experience in adtech / martech, or around server-side tagging (Addingwell relevance).

  • Familiarity with privacy and consent (Didomi relevance).

Tools you'll use

ZoomInfo, Clay, Lemlist and Salesforce, alongside the enrichment and automation stack you will help shape.


Recruitment Process

  • Case Study Presentation with our Revenue Operations Director & CRO
